objects.description: Flat white square top plate with a blue corner logo and a circular recessed area, mounted on the moving lift and carrying the instrument when present.
Black X-shaped scissor mechanism beneath the platform that extends and retracts to change the platform height.
Black handheld digital instrument with a rotary dial and display, resting on the platform top during the elevated portion of the cycle.

uncertainties: The instrument is visible only in elevated frames; the exact moment it is placed on or removed from the platform is not captured, so its presence is tied to the elevated state rather than a specific height.
Sparse sampling means intermediate empty rising frames are not always observed, so the empty mid state can appear on either the rising or descending part of the cycle.
No grasping or hand action is visible; the instrument's appearance/disappearance is recorded only as a visible presence/absence on the platform.
